recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片紅血球大小不均，混有小紅血球、較大圓形紅血球、標靶細胞、鋸齒狀細胞與碎片，部分紅血球內有細小深色點狀包涵體（可能是 Howell-Jolly 小體）；此視野沒有有核紅血球，單看此圖只能說符合嚴重溶血/無效造血型貧血，需配合其他圖片與臨床。
features: Marked anisocytosis with microcytes and larger round cells
Target cells and cells with irregular central pallor
Crenated/echinocytic cells and red cell fragments
Small dark punctate inclusions in a few red cells, possibly Howell-Jolly bodies
No nucleated red cells or leukocytes in this field; scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with microcytes, larger round cells, target cells, crenated forms, and red cell fragments. A few red cells contain small dark punctate inclusions that may represent Howell-Jolly bodies, although the resolution limits characterization. No nucleated red cells or leukocytes are present in this field, and platelets are scattered. In the clinical context and with the other fields from this case, findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia major.

ddx.vs: The smear appearance is indistinguishable; hemoglobin HPLC/electrophoresis is needed.
Post-splenectomy smears show target cells, Howell-Jolly bodies, and acanthocytes but without the marked microcytic anisopoikilocytosis of thalassemia.
IDA shows pencil cells and hypochromic microcytes but not Howell-Jolly bodies or numerous fragments and target cells.
